Hi! I am on a A5 visa and successfully passed the last interview. Misrad hapnim already called a few weeks back to invite me to receive the citizenship but on the date they suggested we couldn’t make it. Since then we haven’t heard from them again, and they are not answering to our emails.
My visa is running out on August 3rd. Any chance they would automatically extend my visa or do you think we need to go there in person without an appointment to request an extension?
Thanks 🙏🏻
